objectives: Resolver 10 ítems de Build a Sentence (como en el blueprint).
Dominar preguntas indirectas, condicionales y relativas.
Detectar errores de orden en las opciones.

words: Risk is inherent in any investment.
to step in to change an outcome
The government intervened to stabilize prices.
How can you justify this expense?
They modified the design to cut costs.
to observe and check over time
Keep a neutral tone in the report.
Remote work has become the norm.
The notion of fairness varies by culture.
The answer is not always obvious.

practice.title: Build a Sentence (10 ítems)
practice.intro: Diez ítems, como en la sección oficial. Hoy sin tiempo; apunta a < 40 s por ítem.

items.context: Why did you choose this university?
items.answer: I chose it because it offers a strong engineering program.
items.explain: because + cláusula; strong engineering program = sustantivo compuesto.

items.context: Have the results been published yet?
items.answer: They will be announced at the end of the month.

items.context: Do you know when the next train leaves?
items.answer: I am not sure what time it departs.
items.explain: Pregunta indirecta: what time it departs (orden afirmativo).

items.context: What would you do if you had more free time?
items.answer: I would join a research group at the university.
The student who works in the lab gave it.
items.explain: Cláusula de relativo: who works in the lab modifica a student.

items.context: Why is the library so crowded today?
items.answer: Many students are preparing for their final exams.

items.context: How did you hear about the scholarship?
items.answer: A friend of mine told me about it.
It suggests that emissions could be reduced significantly.
items.explain: suggests that + cláusula con modal pasivo.

items.context: Could you tell me where the lecture takes place?
items.answer: I believe it takes place in the main auditorium.
Not unless you have a valid reason.
items.explain: Respuesta corta elíptica: not unless + sujeto + verbo.

options: I wonder where is the office.
I wonder where the office is.
I wonder where does the office is.
I wonder the office where is.
If I had known, I would told you.
If I had known, I would have told you.
If I knew, I would have told you.
If I would know, I told you.
quiz.explain: Condicional tipo 3: had + participio → would have + participio.

options: The man whom I spoke yesterday is a professor.
The man to whom I spoke yesterday is a professor.
The man who I spoke to him yesterday is a professor.
The man that to I spoke is a professor.
quiz.explain: Preposición + whom, o «whom/who I spoke to»; no repetir pronombre «him».
